intro: Across 64 articles spanning 12 April 2026 to 8 October 2026, ZCyberNews has tracked ransomware activity involving LockBit, The Gentlemen, and ShinyHunters. Coverage highlights CVE-2026-1731 at CVSS 9.8 and CVE-2026-34197 at CVSS 8.8, alongside CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Healthcare, government, manufacturing, multiple, and education sectors were affected, with incidents reported across North america, Global, United states, Europe, and Turkey. The severity mix comprises 46 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational items.
